item.title: Daily Horoscope for February 22, 2026
item.description: There's no need to be sharp with one another. Fiery Mars leaps into a supportive sextile to healing Chiron, encouraging us to make the first move in mending strained bonds of any type. This is furthered by the affectionate trine between fond Venus and lucky Jupiter at 3:01 pm EST, inviting us to give and receive appreciation in equal measure. Creative solutions could be necessary for any remaining tension, which means we've got permission to have fun with the process of figuring things out.
